description: Worked example composing execution-join-ref-v1's post_commit_consistency invariant (PR#137, 2026-10-18) onto the request_occurrence/task/execution-receipt shape frozen in ogasurfproject-jpg/horizon-shield#51 (pilot scoping, 2026-10-18) and defined in COMPANION_v0.md / PILOT_v0.md at commit 4d720ace (MIT). This is NOT an alternative implementation of authority, payment, or acceptance -- those three roles are covered by MUSUBI/APS (authority_and_payment) and babyblueviper1's work-acceptance-record (acceptance) in the pilot itself, and are declared here, not recomputed. The only invariant this worked example computes is post_commit_consistency: does a LATER, independent observation of the audited output (the JCCDB cost database snapshot, or the deliverable) still match the response_sha256 the execution-receipt committed to at settlement time? Named Case E, not Case D -- ogasurfproject-jpg's own Case D in this issue (astrogilda's: same call contents under a different request occurrence, frozen at 33c22f5a) already holds that letter. Both vectors below use the pilot's own real system outputs (task/request/responses from the actually-deployed worker, not stand-ins), per ogasurfproject-jpg's request (comment, 2026-10-18T15:34:49Z): Case A re-confirms the real, committed live_smoke record diverges from nothing when the dataset has not moved; Case E is the gap after a call settles validly and the JCCDB dataset it was audited against is corrected afterward -- exactly what already happened to this fixture between souba-db 2.2.0 and 2.3.0 on 2026-10-18, independently of this worked example.

pinned_live_data.note: task, request_occurrence (both vectors) and Case A's execution_receipt/post_commit_observation.observed_hash are byte-identical to these committed files -- verified against GitHub's own blob SHA via git hash-object, and independently re-hashed with this repo's jcs.py against the digests ogasurfproject-jpg quoted. See NOTICE.md for the pre-correction (souba-db 2.2.0) values used in Case E, which were never committed as files (the 2.2.0 call was an unlogged smoke test) and are reproduced here only as the full, untruncated hex ogasurfproject-jpg posted directly in the issue thread.

vectors.description: Analogue of the pilot's own Case A (within/paid/accepted). authority_and_payment and acceptance are declared true (out of scope for this worked example -- MUSUBI/APS and invinoveritas's job). post_commit_consistency is computed: the post_commit_observation's observed_hash matches the execution-receipt's response_sha256 exactly, demonstrating the new invariant does not break the happy path. task, request_occurrence and execution_receipt are byte-identical to the pilot's own real, committed live_smoke call (dcbdc5d2) -- not stand-ins. post_commit_observation is this worked example's own illustrative later re-check, not a second call ogasurfproject-jpg actually ran; its observed_hash and dataset_sha256 are the real values from that same commit, reused because audit_estimate is a pure function of (fixture, dataset version) for as long as the dataset does not move -- the pilot's own live_smoke/README.md states this directly: 'it gives these 1400 bytes again for as long as the dataset is 2.3.0.'

post_commit_observation.observer_id: argentum-core-case-e-worked-example (illustrative re-check, same dataset -- not a second real call)

vectors.description: Case E: the gap after a call already settled validly. Same request_occurrence and task as Case A -- the same test payer key and signed test transfer, per ogasurfproject-jpg's own words describing the second call ('the same test payer key and signed test transfer as the first one'). The execution_receipt is the FIRST real call: audited against souba-db 2.2.0, response_sha256 ccfbae3d1fc006b61642da9d240f85c8b380fc10c8694d35d9f5043ca9d45df1, seen_block.height 971954 -- the full, untruncated digest and height ogasurfproject-jpg posted directly (comment, 2026-10-18T06:50:23Z). That call was an unlogged smoke test (no file was ever committed for it), so this vector's execution_receipt omits `signature` and `seen_block.hash` rather than inventing bytes that were never published -- see NOTICE.md. The post_commit_observation is the SECOND real call: the pilot's own committed live_smoke rerun (dcbdc5d2) after souba-db 2.3.0 corrected six price ranges on the same day, observed_hash c2920477d95a8e48f16cc2df49ec58a02cd9b422db491206446e7a5be21937f5, with the new optional dataset_sha256 field (execution-join-ref-v1.2) naming the dataset it was recomputed against -- the exact field ogasurfproject-jpg asked for in the same comment. post_commit_consistency fails -- POST_COMMIT_DIVERGENCE -- while every other invariant, including the original call's own validity, remains true. Nobody misstated anything at settlement; the database the estimate was audited against was corrected afterward, and both releases are anchored (2.2.0: JIDEC entry 42, Bitcoin block 966969; 2.3.0: JIDEC entry 114).
vectors.failure_detail: execution_receipt.outcome.response_sha256=ccfbae3d1fc0… (committed at seen_block.height=971954, souba-db 2.2.0). post_commit_observation.observed_hash=c2920477d95a… (souba-db 2.3.0, dataset_sha256=7b16600e50ed…) for the same request_sha256=69546501c862…. The two hashes differ because the dataset the estimate was audited against was corrected between the two calls, not because either call misreported anything.
